== Published persona-reference states ==
The front changes “If The Trace Was Correct” to “Your Spies Have Located A Jedi?” and “Galen’s Fighter” to “Rogue Shadow”, and requires the lightsaber hit and departure to occur “on the same turn”. The back adds “or if neither Vader nor Galen is on table” to the flip condition. Both release and master images were read directly. The release copies and master compilation do not by themselves establish every effective date. Intermediate wording recorded in the team errata inventory still requires its own source check; it has not been collapsed into a claim of exactly two historical states.
